تمتعضي (form VIII)
# تَمْتَعِضِي (tamtaʕiḍī) /tam.ta.ʕi.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# تُمْتَعَضِي (tumtaʕaḍī) /tum.ta.ʕa.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
